monitoring_count_contract.monitoring_object_count: COUNT DISTINCT monitoring_object_id where status in evaluated_hit/evaluated_clear；按object_type分别统计
monitoring_count_contract.required_object_count: COUNT DISTINCT monitoring_object_id where required and status not in not_applicable/reference_only/not_due
monitoring_count_contract.hit_object_count: COUNT DISTINCT monitoring_object_id linked to effective_result=hit；含未复核线索及后续整改闭环事实，不含已确认误报的排除事实
monitoring_count_contract.matched_rule_count: COUNT DISTINCT rule_id of effective_result=hit evaluations；一条规则多对象命中不重复规则数
monitoring_count_contract.open_case_count: COUNT DISTINCT risk_id linked to selected rows or risk_context_links, excluding closed/excluded；业务阶段已完成不排除
monitoring_count_contract.rectified_closed_case_count: COUNT DISTINCT risk_id with status closed at snapshot and close_reason=rectified and passed verification evidence/action and verified_closed_at within selected period；excluded不计入
monitoring_count_contract.overdue_rectification_count: COUNT DISTINCT risk_id with status rectifying/pending_verification and active rectification due date < snapshot date
monitoring_count_contract.responsible_unit_count: COUNT DISTINCT owner_org_id in selected hit objects，非监测对象数
monitoring_count_contract.zero_semantics: 0表示有效监测中没有该类事实；未接入/数据不足显示—及状态，不将空值转0
monitoring_count_contract.period_semantics: 监测/命中对象按所选观察期有效评估；未关闭事项按截至日存量，不得因first_seen_at早于本期而删除；本期已整改闭环按所选期间内复核关闭时间且截至仍closed、原因rectified。存量与流量分别标识，不直接计算一个闭环率。历史遗留但本期未评估对象单独标识，不伪增本期监测对象。
monitoring_count_contract.window_aliases: window_start/window_end为观察窗口起止；period_start/period_end为其兼容别名，必须相等。查询按window_end落所选期间且evaluated_at<=as_of，引用历史数据窗口单列，不按窗口重叠分摊。
monitoring_count_contract.reevaluation_note: 同一观察窗重跑去重；后续未命中不能覆盖未核销的既有有效命中及历史事项，需保留评估历史和事实处理关系。
monitoring_count_contract.coverage_note: 部分覆盖时可以展示已计算数量，但必须同时标记部分覆盖，并在详情列出应监测、已监测及数据不足对象。跨场景/阶段汇总必须重新去重。
